content: agentskills.io spec: SKILL.md needs name (1-64, lowercase a-z0-9 and hyphens, no leading/trailing/double hyphen, must match directory name) and description (1-1024). Optional license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools. Body under 500 lines recommended. Discovery paths differ per runtime: Claude Code .claude/skills only; Cursor .cursor/skills and .agents/skills plus compat .claude/skills and .codex/skills; Copilot .github/skills, .claude/skills, .agents/skills; Codex .agents/skills in repo and ~/.codex/skills global. Strict validators (claude.ai upload, skills-ref) reject unknown keys such as argument-hint or disable-model-invocation.
